# Notice and attribution

New material in this directory is by Rohan Guliani (@Rohansguliani) and is
released under Apache-2.0. Substantial AI assistance was used in the
derivation, implementation and writing. No human peer review or
proof-assistant verification is claimed.

Predecessor work:

* **#621, Ali Romman (aliromman).** Kernel and the `L`-uniform circle and
  inverse bounds (`research/prime-power-cyclic-inverse`).
* **#628, Chafik Boukhalfa (chafreaky).** Certified approximate
  factorization, preparation and phase budgets, the two-scan primitive, the
  dirty-shear composition and the sort-route layout charge. The files in
  `vendor/` are byte-identical to #628 head `0768f97d`. Its notice is
  retained in `vendor/PR628-NOTICE.md`.
* **#764, Charles Bethin (cbethin).** The shared-suffix identity
  `1-Q >= beta G` and the inverse-square scan bound, used in Lemma 1. No
  #764 code is consumed.

The two-stack queue and Euclidean stride reduction are standard techniques.
No literature-priority claim is made.
